features.name: Vaultor Next foundation
features.description: Experimental Windows Tauri notes with indexed managed search, protected drafts, collection organization, protected linked NTFS Markdown and a full-workspace desktop shell with OLED, companion navigation and shared panes. Managed file/folder copies, resource exports, portable workspace transfers and Rust-owned background Activity are in development. M8 adds tags, pins, persistent Recents, recoverable Trash and Activity-backed permanent deletion. M9 adds managed rich editor/slash/table controls, image and text previews, stable resource links/backlinks, membership clipboard, collection pointer drops and prepared native copies. M10 adds full Collections/Tags/Linked Sources browsers, functional local Settings, command palette/custom bindings and workspace session restoration. M11 shares the original resource-row, Library and managed-note orientation, contextual sidebar and window-control presentation with Rust-backed operations. M12 extends shared transforming headers to organization browsers, adds the original All/Hierarchy switch and parent breadcrumbs, adapts original Settings and searchable offline Help, and shares linked-note framing with safe formatting controls. M13 restores the floating Settings frame, persistent 60–100% pane/menu opacity, original desktop/sidebar proportions, compact footer and header formatting disclosure; visual and motion acceptance remains screen-specific. M14 adapts the original session/journey controller, Open Notes and reading restoration, Quick Access group preferences, managed Notes/Files filters, density, floating sidebar and confirmed profile resets; remaining interaction and motion acceptance is explicit. M15 restores workspace behavior controls, mixed collection/resource pins, session arrangement, view-identity cycling, title editing and taxonomy/file-category filters.
